description: Implementation of the ExponentialBiased class methods for generating biased exponential random numbers, including GetSkipCount, GetStride, and Initialize, within the absl profiling internal namespace.

classes.name: ExponentialBiased
classes.description: Class providing methods to generate biased exponential random numbers, including skip count and stride calculations.

methods.name: GetSkipCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of steps to skip based on a biased exponential distribution, given a mean.

methods.name: GetStride
methods.description: Returns the stride length based on the mean, using GetSkipCount.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the internal state of the ExponentialBiased object, seeding the random number generator.
